answer_1.quote: we finetune a sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) model to generate an event (v), emotion (e), and moral (m)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate empathy reasoning performance using BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, and BertScore

answer_3.quote: we feed the same prompt given to human annotators into ChatGPT, asking for a Likert score from 1-4 for the empathic similarity between two stories

answer_4.quote: Our human evaluation is a full user study to see how the model performs given a story that the users told themselves
answer_4.guideline: We used a shortened version of the State Empathy Survey, which contains 7 questions covering affective, cognitive, and associative aspects of situational empathy
